victor_gate_lie.title: Victor's Gate Entry Lie
victor_gate_lie.description: Victor claimed he never went near Arthur's mansion tonight, but the security gate logs show his vehicle entered the estate at 10:45 PM.

james_study_lie.title: James's Study Visit Lie
james_study_lie.description: James claimed he spent the entire night in the kitchen, but hallway footage shows a hooded figure matching his height entering the study corridor at 11:10 PM.
